title: Large Granite Field/Stream Boulder — rounded, mossy top
region_context: Ukrainian Shield granite outcrops; Steppe/Forest-Steppe ecotone fields and riparian stream banks

sources.wentworth_1922: Wentworth, C.K. (1922). A scale of grade and class terms for clastic sediments. Journal of Geology 30(5):377–392. [Via Wikipedia 'Grain size (geology)']: boulder class = any rock clast with diameter > 256 mm (0.256 m); 'large boulder' subclass > 512 mm (0.512 m); 'very large boulder' > 4096 mm by some extensions.
sources.boulder_field_obs: General field-geology observation, confirmed across multiple sources: 'large' field/stream boulders (single-hand-carry to immovable) in European landscape contexts typically range 0.5–1.5 m across the long axis. [BGS (British Geological Survey) — 'Rocks and Minerals'; practical geomorphology field guides.] No single ГОСТ or ISO standard specifies 'large boulder' game-prop dimensions — acknowledged in needs[].
sources.ukrainian_shield: Granite outcrops (granites, migmatites, gneisses) are the bedrock of the Ukrainian Shield (Zhytomyr–Khmelnytsky–Dnipropetrovsk region); rounded boulders result from spheroidal weathering in riparian and loess-steppe contexts. [Encyclopedia of Ukraine — Ukrainian Shield; Shcherbak et al., 'Precambrian of Ukraine', 2005.]
sources.moss_ecology_rock: Saxicolous (rock-dwelling) bryophytes colonise exposed granite surfaces; moisture-accumulating top/N-facing faces develop persistent moss mats (Grimmia spp., Racomitrium spp., Andreaea rupestris); shaded concavities can reach 40–80% coverage. [Wikipedia 'Saxicolous' + 'Grimmia'; EUNIS habitat type 5.3 — Inland siliceous rocky pavements and outcrops. Qualitative; exact % coverage in needs[].]

boulder_class.note: Classified under Wentworth 'large boulder' (> 512 mm long axis); for visual coverage prop this implies ~1100–1400 mm across the widest face.

boulder_size_range.note: Field range for a 'large' immovable granite boulder in steppe/riparian context. Chosen model falls within this envelope.

boulder_chosen_dims.note: Game-model target. Long axis (X) = 1100 mm, height (Y) = 860 mm, depth (Z) = 1020 mm. Values are within the sourced boulder_size_range; specific mm values are game-design choices (cover prop at human scale 1.75 m) — not independently measured from a named specimen. Exact site-specific dimensions in needs[].
boulder_chosen_dims.derivation: DERIVED from boulder_size_range: long_axis at 73% of range max (1500 mm → 1100 mm); height at 56% (860/1500); short_axis at 68% (1020/1500). All within sourced envelope. Stacked bevelBox layers taper from 1100 mm base to 480 mm top cap — approximates natural spheroidal-weathering profile.

boulder_form.description: Rounded sub-spherical mass from spheroidal weathering; widest at mid-height; tapers outward at base. Irregular protrusions on one or two faces common — un-exfoliated 'ears' of harder crystal band. Deep near-vertical cracks common on exposed faces (thermal expansion + freeze-thaw). Ground contact is darker (soil/moisture staining).
boulder_form.lobe_note: Protrusions (lobes) are game-design placement choices consistent with the sourced boulder_form description; their exact size/position are design values, not independently measured. See needs[].

granite_character.appearance: Medium-to-coarse crystalline igneous rock; grey to light-grey surface on dry faces (feldspar/quartz/hornblende); orange-brown patina on weathered faces from iron-oxide release; salt-and-pepper speckle at close range (not resolvable in 0.04–0.06 m voxel range).
granite_character.palette_mat: granite — hi:#a8a8a4 / mid:#787874 / lo:#585854 / slot:#3c3c38 (cool grey, low chroma, roughness 0.70)

moss_coverage.description: Persistent moss mat on top surface and shaded shoulders; dominated by Grimmia and Racomitrium spp. on dry/exposed granite; moist faces up to 40–80% vegetative cover. Modelled as a thin graniteMoss layer on the topmost surfaces — top cap and upper shoulder patches.
moss_coverage.thickness_mm: 10–20 (voxel: modelled at 40–60 mm to be legible at game scale)

feature_inventory.feature: Main rounded granite body — stacked bevelBox taper (base → mid → upper → top)
Widest layer at bottom (spheroidal weathering base spread)
Moss crown — top surface moss mat (thickest, most sheltered accumulation)
Moss shoulder patches L/R — irregular partial cover on upper shoulders
Vertical crack detail on right face — thermal/freeze-thaw fissure (dark charBlack strip)
Layered shading via bevelBox bright/mid/lo tones — lit top, mid body, shadow foot

game_model_purpose: Scatter prop for steppe/riparian world zones — provides player partial-cover and breaks sightlines on open terrain. Floor-anchored, static.
needs: Exact dimensions of a named reference boulder in Ukrainian Shield region — no sourced specific specimen available; boulder_chosen_dims are within the sourced range but not measured from a real rock
Quantified moss coverage percentage (area fraction) for exposed granite outcrops in Continental European steppe climate — moss_ecology_rock gives qualitative 40–80%; precise figure unsourced
Exact lobe size/position — described as game-design choices consistent with boulder_form; a photogrammetric scan of a representative Ukrainian granite boulder would resolve this
